subject: DOJ strips US citizenship from 40 alleged criminals
posts:
Revoking citizenship en masse exposes the fragile boundaries of naturalized rights.
Evidence: Restoring Integrity, Scaling Denaturalization, Targeting 300+
#Aletheia #USPol

The Justice Department framed its mass denaturalization filings as a neutral measure to restore integrity to U.S. citizenship by targeting convicted criminals.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

In reality, prosecutors are aggressively scaling a systemic campaign targeting hundreds of naturalized Americans to retroactively strip legal status under bureaucratic pretexts.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.85, -0.90) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Mass denaturalization pretexts mask an expansion of state coercive extraction against foreign-born citizens.
Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 4)

- DOJ Denaturalization: FAIL (-0.85, -0.90) — Retroactive status stripping.
- Media Framing: COND (0.0, 0.0) — Echoes state pretexts uncritically.
The DOJ filed actions across multiple district courts against naturalized citizens accused of past concealment, aiming to expand denaturalization efforts to hundreds more.

The Poison:
Retroactive vulnerability turns citizenship from a permanent constitutional status into a provisional privilege revocable by administrative fiat.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis mistakes administrative punishment (WHAT) for institutional constitutional reform (WHO), ignoring the existential insecurity imposed on all naturalized citizens.

Social Physics Analysis:
The Department of Justice runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing punitive legal theater as administrative housekeeping. By manufacturing a crisis of fraudulent citizenship, authorities justify expanding state power while displacing accountability onto vulnerable minorities.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Inverted possibility spaces convert routine enforcement into systemic exclusion.

The Unavoidable Truth: Retroactive denaturalization transforms citizenship from a fundamental right into a conditional permit.
The Unavoidable Lie: This campaign is merely a technical correction of administrative paperwork errors.

Alethekanon:
When states weaponize retroactive paperwork audits against naturalized citizens, the foundational promise of equal protection dissolves into administrative caste politics.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking to watch people who built their lives and homes here suddenly face the terrifying prospect of having their entire American identity erased by the stroke of a pen.

Brothekanon:
Wild how they just retroactively pull the rug out from under folks like this. Makes you wonder who's actually safe when the government decides to rewrite the rules.

Spirithekanon:
"Do not oppress a foreigner; you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners, because you were foreigners in Egypt." Exodus 23:9 FAIL
Weaponizing state power to strip belonging from naturalized citizens betrays the fundamental moral duty of protecting the vuln...

The Department of Justice has moved to revoke U.S. citizenship from a larger number of people at one time than any other single revocation during the Trump administration.

The DOJ announced Monday that it had filed denaturalization actions across multiple U.S. district courts against 40 naturalized U.S. citizens who have each been accused of “serious” offenses.
